say:1:1541113001:1.text: Oh great, here we go again. That weird look in your eyes.
say:1:1541113001:1.source_cn: 啊，又来了。又是那种奇怪的眼神。
say:1:1541113001:1.male: Oh great, here we go again. That weird look in your eyes.
say:1:1541113001:1.female: Oh great, here we go again. That weird look in your eyes.

say:2:1541113002:1.text: Go on then. What is it this time?
say:2:1541113002:1.male: Go on then. What is it this time?
say:2:1541113002:1.female: Go on then. What is it this time?

choice_prompt:3:1541113002.text: Go on then. What is it this time?
choice_prompt:3:1541113002.male: Go on then. What is it this time?
choice_prompt:3:1541113002.female: Go on then. What is it this time?

say:4:1541113003:1.text: What can I say? God of Death seems to follow me around. Wherever I go, disaster happens.
say:4:1541113003:1.source_cn: 谁让我是一个被死神追逐的家伙，走到哪都会遇到灾难。
say:4:1541113003:1.male: What can I say? God of Death seems to follow me around. Wherever I go, disaster happens.
say:4:1541113003:1.female: What can I say? God of Death seems to follow me around. Wherever I go, disaster happens.

say:5:1541113004:1.text: But don't blame me for it. I'm not the one causing it.
say:5:1541113004:1.source_cn: 但这不能怪我，又不是我造成的。
say:5:1541113004:1.male: But don't blame me for it. I'm not the one causing it.
say:5:1541113004:1.female: But don't blame me for it. I'm not the one causing it.

say:7:1541113005:1.text: When death comes knocking, you learn more from a corpse than you'd think. And knowing how someone died is the only way to stop the next one.
say:7:1541113005:1.source_cn: 当死神降临大地，以灾祸收割灵魂时，研究尸体可以帮助我们...

say:8:1541113006:1.text: Before I met Morgan, I thought I was the only one crazy enough to think that way. Turns out, he'd taken it even further.
say:8:1541113006:1.source_cn: 遇见摩根以前，我曾以为只有我一人敢做此假设。摩根的见解...

say:9:1541113007:1.text: From what I've heard... it all started because of a friend. That true?
say:9:1541113007:1.source_cn: 而据我所知……这是因为他的一位朋友。你说对吗？

say:10:1541113008:1.text: If I said no, would anyone believe me?

choice_prompt:11:1541113008.text: If I said no, would anyone believe me?

say:13:1541113010:1.text: It's just one of those tired old stories. Not nearly as juicy as you think.
say:13:1541113010:1.source_cn: 是一个老套的故事，没你想象中那么有趣。

say:14:1541113011:1.text: Kid was scavenging weapons off a battlefield. Found another kid his age, half-dead in a ditch. Took him home, patched him up, shared what little food he had.
say:14:1541113011:1.source_cn: 一个小孩来战场上捡破烂的武器，捡到了一个昏在壕沟里的同...

say:15:1541113012:1.text: But plagues follow war like vultures. When sickness hit that wreck of a village, nobody could escape it.
say:15:1541113012:1.source_cn: 可是瘟疫经常伴随战争而来。当疾病蔓延到那座残破的小村庄...

say:16:1541113013:1.text: Everyone died—except the kid he saved.
say:16:1541113013:1.source_cn: 唯一一个例外，是那个被他捡回家的孩子。

say:17:1541113014:1.text: Lucky break or cruel joke, who knows? Kid lived. Turns out, he had a spark of magic in him.
say:17:1541113014:1.source_cn: 不知道是倒霉还是幸运，这个孩子活下来了。而恰好，他有那...

say:18:1541113015:1.text: That bit of magic convinced him of one thing: you can't change a war, but you can still save a dying person.
say:18:1541113015:1.source_cn: 也是因为这一点魔力，让他总觉得魔法可以改变很多。就算扭...

choice_prompt:19:1541113015.text: That bit of magic convinced him of one thing: you can't change a war, but you can still save a dying person.
choice_prompt:19:1541113015.source_cn: 也是因为这一点魔力，让他总觉得魔法可以改变很多。就算扭转不了战局，至少也能拯救一个生病的人吧。

say:20:1541113016:1.text: That's it. You already know how the rest.
say:20:1541113016:1.source_cn: 没了。我懒得讲完，反正你能猜到。
say:20:1541113016:1.male: That's it. You already know how the rest.
say:20:1541113016:1.female: That's it. You already know how the rest.

say:21:1541113017:1.text: Maybe it was me. Maybe it wasn't. Take it however you like.
say:21:1541113017:1.source_cn: 这只是一个故事，不一定是我。随便你怎么理解。
say:21:1541113017:1.male: Maybe it was me. Maybe it wasn't. Take it however you like.
say:21:1541113017:1.female: Maybe it was me. Maybe it wasn't. Take it however you like.

say:22:1541113018:1.text: Anyway, digging through the dead doesn't bring them peace, but it might help keep more people alive.
say:22:1541113018:1.source_cn: 总之，研究尸体不能让死者获得安息，但或许可以保住更多人...

say:23:1541113019:1.text: Call it disrespect if you want. Dead's dead. I care more about saving the ones who aren't.
say:23:1541113019:1.source_cn: 比起亵不亵渎尸体，反正人都死了。让还活着的人活下去更重要。

choice:19:1:2.text: That kid was you, wasn't it?
choice:19:1:2.source_cn: 活下来的那个孩子就是你？
choice:19:1:2.male: That kid was you, wasn't it?
choice:19:1:2.female: That kid was you, wasn't it?

choice:19:2:3.text: Didn't know you had a story like that.
choice:19:2:3.source_cn: 没想到你还有这么一段故事
choice:19:2:3.male: Didn't know you had a story like that.
choice:19:2:3.female: Didn't know you had a story like that.

choice:11:0:1.text: Oho? There's a story? Spill it!
choice:11:0:1.male: Oho? There's a story? Spill it!
choice:11:0:1.female: Oho? There's a story? Spill it!

choice:3:0:1.text: You deal with dead bodies a lot.
choice:3:0:1.source_cn: 你似乎经常和尸体打交道
choice:3:0:1.male: You deal with dead bodies a lot.
choice:3:0:1.female: You deal with dead bodies a lot.
